name: pnpm Store (shared)
description: Shares a single pnpm content-addressable store across every local devcontainer for this host OS user and across rebuilds via a Docker named volume, so no stray .pnpm-store folders pollute your repos and packages aren't re-downloaded per project. Zero-config and autonomous: the volume is created automatically, with no host directory to pre-create. Also self-heals your devcontainer setup.
